items.title: Fee income divergence widens among listed banks
items.description: Third-quarter results from China's listed banks reveal a widening divergence in fee and commission income, a key component of non-interest revenue. Some large State-owned commercial banks and leading joint-stock commercial banks continue to outperform in wealth management and distribution services, leveraging their advantages in customer bases, products and distribution channels. By contrast, many city commercial banks and rural commercial lenders are facing mounting pressure on fee-based income.
